name: Robotnik Button
look: Two stacked panels. Top: a drawn cartoon hand reaches for a blue button, next to a red button, on a pale blue control panel. Bottom: Jim Carrey as Dr. Robotnik, in a red flight suit with goggles on his head and a big mustache, gleefully slams a red button with his gloved fist.
use: The blue button is the sensible choice and the red one the reckless one. Instead of the calm hand pressing blue, Robotnik happily smashes red, showing someone gleefully picking the bad option.
describe: villain gleefully smashing the red button instead of the blue one
